name: Norfolk Telecom satellite backhaul service (Telstra contract)
developer: Norfolk Telecom / Norfolk Island Regional Council with Telstra (satellite backhaul contractor)
notes: Per NF methodology this is telecom_backhaul / satellite connectivity, NOT a commercial datacenter (no colo/rack/hosting service confirmed). NIRC 2026-04-02 official news confirms Telstra satellite backhaul for Norfolk Telecom under a 2023 tender contract (initial term to 2026-01, service level/cost under renegotiation); federal minister release and National Tribune report the satellite network capacity upgrade (~4x). Satellite backhaul bandwidth is connectivity, not DC MW; capacity_mw null.

name: Norfolk Telecom core / exchange / network office equipment
notes: Telecom_exchange_or_core per methodology: Norfolk Telecom operates fixed/mobile/broadband/international connectivity on-island; 2015 federal Mobile Network Review records PSTN (copper/some fibre, Ericsson AXE switch), GSM core/BSC/BTS, base-station shelters and an office able to house core network equipment; NIRC page and ni.net.nf confirm current operator service. Not a commercial DC: no colocation/rack-rental product, capacity not disclosed (capacity_mw null).

name: O3b satellite earth-station / backhaul facilities (historical)
notes: Satellite_earth_station_or_backhaul: 2015 federal review confirms two O3b satellite dishes built 2014 and O3b IP satellite + C8 backup used for international connectivity at that time; current primary backhaul is the Telstra satellite contract per NIRC 2026. Classified as telecom asset, not commercial DC; current operational role of the O3b earth-station needs A-grade NIRC/Telstra update. capacity_mw null (no IT load disclosed).

name: NIRC Power house / electricity reticulation
notes: Power_utility per methodology: NIRC officially splits electricity services into Power house (incl. mechanical workshop) + reticulation; small island grid historically diesel-based with recent rooftop solar/battery and BESY energy platform. This is a utility/grid-constraint baseline, NOT a datacenter; power-system capacity must not be converted to DC MW (capacity_mw null). No large-load datacenter power/planning evidence found.

name: Norfolk Island Data Services (NIDS) / .nf ccTLD registry & ISP services
notes: Registry/ISP service per methodology: IANA records NIDS as .nf ccTLD manager (Norfolk Island address); NIDS also offers internet/VoIP/NBN/Sky Muster-type services. Proves domain/registry/ISP service existence, NOT a local server hall or colocation facility; excluded as DC. Negative baseline for the division (checked 2026-08-12): no AWS/Azure/GCP/OCI region or local zone for Norfolk Island on official provider pages, no IXP, no verified commercial colocation market; SEO 'Norfolk Island data center/VPS' pages are C-grade false positives. No commercial datacenter activity on Norfolk Island.
